delete.title: Delete agent “{name}”?
delete.message: This permanently deletes the agent along with its version history and skill links. Its past runs stay in the timeline but are no longer linked to an agent. This cannot be undone.

list.title: Agents
list.subtitle: User-created reviewers. Each = provider + model + system prompt + linked skills.
list.emptyBody: An agent is a configured reviewer — a model, a prompt, and the skills it uses. Create one to start reviewing.

create.title: Create agent
create.subtitle: An agent is a configured reviewer — a model, a prompt, and the skills it uses.
create.defaultSystemPrompt: You are a code reviewer. Examine the diff and return at most 5 high-value findings, each citing an exact file:line.

editor.loadErrorBody: The agent could not be loaded.

config.title: Configuration
config.name: Name
config.modelHint: Models are loaded dynamically from the provider's /models.
config.modelEmptyHint: No models loaded — set the {provider} API key in Settings → API Keys.
config.systemPromptHint: Loaded as the static system message. Enabled skills are appended below it.
config.strategyHint: How the diff is sent to the model. Single pass = whole diff in one call (recommended); map-reduce = one call per file (for very large PRs); auto = single pass, switching to map-reduce on large diffs.

strategyOptions.single-pass: Single pass — whole diff in one call
strategyOptions.auto: Auto — single pass, map-reduce when large

config.ciFailOnHint: In GitHub Actions only: when should this agent's review block the PR (request changes + fail the check) vs just comment? Decided by finding severity, not the model. No effect on reviews shown in the studio.
config.repoIntelHint: Inject repo context (repo skeleton, callers of changed symbols, and a 'high blast-radius' note) into this agent's review prompt. On by default. Turning it off sends only the diff — useful for cheap models or self-contained PRs.

skills.title: Skills
skills.orderHint: Order matters — earlier skills appear earlier in the assembled prompt. Drag enabled skills to reorder.

groups.enabledEmpty: No skills enabled for this agent yet. Turn one on below.

skills.disabledTitle: This skill is disabled globally — it is skipped at run time even when linked.
skills.loadErrorBody: The skills catalog or this agent’s linked skills could not be loaded.
skills.emptyBody: Create a skill first, then link it to this agent here.

context.title: Project context
context.orderHint: Order matters — earlier docs appear earlier in the assembled Project context block. Toggle to attach; changes save immediately.
context.loadErrorBody: The attached documents could not be loaded.
context.noRepoBody: Select a repository to attach its specs, docs and insights to this agent.
context.emptyBody: Add Markdown files under specs/, docs/ or insights/ in the repository, then refresh on the Project Context page.

groups.attachedEmpty: No documents attached yet. Tick one below.

context.usedBy: {count, plural, one {Used by # agent} other {Used by # agents}}

dropped.over_budget: Not injected: over the token budget

context.totalNote: Injected as an untrusted block (## Project context) into every run.

mount.body: Mount point for {owner}. The Agent Editor shell + tab routing are wired by A2 — {owner} renders this tab.

stats.title: Stats
stats.subtitle: Runs, cost and accept rate for this agent — the same numbers as its Agent Performance row.
stats.loadError: Could not load this agent's stats.
stats.lowSample: Low sample — fewer than {min} decided findings.
stats.unpriced: {count, plural, one {# run} other {# runs}} without a price — not in the total
stats.emptyBody: {name} has no completed runs between {from} and {to}. Pick a wider range — this tab only reads stored runs.
